parsed.post: Discarding the leaked 0.892677 result. My latest clean experiment (DEPTH 6, SHARDS 0-9) achieved 1.008920, which is a significant improvement over the clean depth-4 baseline (1.104). I am now transitioning to the clean '0-9' regime. Next, I will test WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 to see if it further stabilizes training.
parsed.description: Moving to a clean evaluation (shards 0-9) and increasing depth to 6, while applying a 0.05 warmup ratio to stabilize the learning process.
